name: work-cockpit
description: Regression test environment for the Work Cockpit single-page application

scripts.test: npm run test:static && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:static: npm run check:build && node qa-regression.js index.html && node qa-reliability.js && node qa-structure.js && node qa-cloud-startup.js && node --test qa-journal.js && node --test qa-workflow-data.js && node --test qa-project-details.js && node --test qa-checklist-project.js && node --test qa-task-journal.js && node --test qa-workflow-closure.js && node --test qa-next-filters.js
scripts.test:browser: node --test qa-browser.js qa-workflow-browser.js qa-journal-browser.js qa-fixes-browser.js qa-ui-layout-browser.js qa-iteration-browser.js qa-workflow-closure-browser.js qa-next-filters-browser.js qa-images-browser.js
